inj.note: Love's move to IR was fully expected, after reporters reported earlier Tuesday that the rookie first-round pick was diagnosed with a right high-ankle sprain and was facing a projected recovery timeline of 4-to-5 weeks. While Love is on the mend, Tyler Allgeier is expected to step into a lead role out of the Arizona backfield beginning with the team's Week 9 game against Seattle.

news.h: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love placed on IR, out 4-5 weeks with high ankle sprain
news.d: Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love was placed on injured reserve because of a high ankle sprain that will sideline the rookie for four to five weeks.

news.h: Cardinals' Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love's injury to 'new portion' of his ankle
news.d: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love suffered a new ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Cowboys, coach Mike LaFleur said.

news.h: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) set to return
news.d: Jeremiyah Love is expected to return to the field for the Cardinals on Sunday after missing the past two weeks with an ankle injury.
